map.根据IIF免疫荧光模式+ELISA靶抗原(MPO/PR3)结果对ANCA相关血管: Classifies ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV) by IIF immunofluorescence pattern + ELISA target antigen (MPO/PR3)
map.📋 ANCA IIF模式与靶抗原对应: 📋 ANCA IIF Pattern vs Target Antigen
map.提示：2017年EULAR/ACR强调用抗原特异性ELISA(PR3/MPO)替: Note: 2017 EULAR/ACR emphasizes antigen-specific ELISA (PR3/MPO) over IIF as first-line testing. PR3-ANCA and MPO-ANCA subtyping predicts phenotype and prognosis better than disease classification (GPA/MPA). PR3-ANCA positive: more ENT/pulmonary involvement, higher relapse risk; MPO-ANCA positive: heavier renal involvement, lower relapse risk. ANCA-negative does not exclude AAV (especially EGPA). For clinical reference only.
map.PR3 阳性、MPO 阴性、IIF cANCA、高滴度(≥1:320)，伴肾+肺: PR3 positive, MPO negative, IIF cANCA, high titer (>=1:320), with renal+pulmonary involvement -> supports granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA), needs induction remission therapy.
map.MPO 阳性、PR3 阴性、pANCA → microscopic polyan: MPO positive, PR3 negative, pANCA -> microscopic polyangiitis, mainly renal/pulmonary small-vessel vasculitis.
map.PR3-ANCA 多对应 GPA，MPO-ANCA 多对应 MPA/EGPA；滴: PR3-ANCA mostly corresponds to GPA, MPO-ANCA to MPA/EGPA; titer level suggests activity and relapse risk.
map.cANCA 多与 PR3 相关、pANCA 多与 MPO 相关，但确诊以抗原特异: cANCA often relates to PR3, pANCA to MPO, but confirmation relies on antigen-specific ELISA.
